# SCHADS Award Increase 2026: What’s Changing on 1 July (Full Rate Table)
## What happens next: Schedule E rises 15% on 1 December 2026
- **From 1 December 2026:** employees engaged under **Schedule E** (home care, disability care) receive an initial **15 per cent increase** (14.96 and 13.31 per cent at Levels E.4.2 and E.5.2). The Commission first proposed 1 October 2026, then deferred the start in its final decision, [[2026] FWCFB 232](https://www.fwc.gov.au/documents/decisionssigned/pdf/2026fwcfb232.pdf) of 11 September 2026. Any remaining increase applies when the new classification structure starts on 1 October 2027.
